lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill region; inter-blob spacing is relatively uniform vertically but increases horizontally towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the upper two-thirds of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located on the distal half of the fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of small-diameter, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more closely packed than the primary flank blobs.
